package engine

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/internal/configuration"
	"github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/internal/diff"
	"github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/internal/engine/workdir"
	"github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/internal/engine/workerpool"
	"github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/internal/gomodule"
	"github.com/go-gremlins/gremlins/internal/mutator"
)

var diagnosticOutputMutex sync.Mutex

func diagnosticEmit(event map[string]any) {
	diagnosticOutputMutex.Lock()
	defer diagnosticOutputMutex.Unlock()
	_ = json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(event)
}

func diagnosticPhase(args []string) string {
	if slices.Contains(args, "^Test") {
		return "unit"
	}
	return "full"
}

func diagnosticObservedRun(cmd *exec.Cmd, ctx context.Context) (func(), error) {
	started := time.Now()
	deadline, hasDeadline := ctx.Deadline()
	diagnosticEmit(map[string]any{"event": "run_enter", "phase": diagnosticPhase(cmd.Args), "has_deadline": hasDeadline, "remaining_ms": time.Until(deadline).Milliseconds()})
	release, err := run(cmd)
	exitCode := -1
	if cmd.ProcessState != nil {
		exitCode = cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()
	}
	diagnosticEmit(map[string]any{"event": "run_return", "phase": diagnosticPhase(cmd.Args), "elapsed_ms": time.Since(started).Milliseconds(), "process_started": cmd.Process != nil, "wait_returned": cmd.ProcessState != nil, "exit_code": exitCode, "deadline_exceeded": ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded, "error": err != nil})
	return release, err
}

func TestNativeCLISingleMutation(t *testing.T) {
	root := os.Getenv("GOLIB_NATIVE_SOURCE_ROOT")
	budget, err := time.ParseDuration(os.Getenv("GOLIB_NATIVE_PHASE_BUDGET"))
	if err != nil || budget <= 0 || !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
		t.Fatal("invalid native diagnostic inputs")
	}
	for _, key := range []string{"GOCACHE", "GOMODCACHE", "GOTMPDIR", "GOFLAGS", "GOWORK"} {
		t.Setenv(key, os.Getenv("GOLIB_NATIVE_EXEC_"+key))
	}
	t.Setenv("GOLIB_NATIVE_CLI_DIAGNOSTIC", "")
	mod, err := gomodule.Init(root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("native module discovery failed")
	}
	mod.CallingDir = "internal/cli"
	original, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, mod.CallingDir, "cli.go"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("native source acquisition failed")
	}
	lines := bytes.Split(original, []byte("\n"))
	if len(lines) < 138 || !bytes.Contains(lines[137], []byte("256 << 20")) {
		t.Fatal("native mutation source expression changed")
	}
	configuration.Reset()
	defer configuration.Reset()
	configuration.Set(configuration.UnleashIntegrationMode, true)
	configuration.Set(configuration.UnleashTimeoutCoefficientKey, 1)
	configuration.Set(configuration.UnleashTestCPUKey, 1)
	configuration.Set(configuration.UnleashTagsKey, "")
	configuration.Set(configuration.UnleashDryRunKey, false)
	configuration.Set(configuration.MutantTypeEnabledKey(mutator.InvertBitwise), true)
	changes, err := diff.New(mod.Root)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("native no-diff discovery failed")
	}
	stream := make(chan mutator.Mutator)
	engine := Engine{module: mod, fs: os.DirFS(filepath.Join(root, mod.CallingDir)), codeData: CodeData{Diff: changes}, mutantStream: stream}
	go func() {
		engine.runOnFile("cli.go")
		close(stream)
	}()
	var selected mutator.Mutator
	count := 0
	for candidate := range stream {
		position := candidate.Position()
		if candidate.Type() == mutator.InvertBitwise && position.Filename == "cli.go" && position.Line == 138 && position.Column == 25 {
			selected = candidate
			count++
		}
	}
	if count != 1 || selected.Status() != mutator.Runnable || selected.(*TokenMutator).tokenNode.Tok() != token.SHL {
		t.Fatal("native exact runnable shift discovery was not unique")
	}
	workingRoot := t.TempDir()
	wd := workdir.NewCachedDealer(workingRoot, root)
	defer wd.Clean()
	observed := func(ctx context.Context, name string, args ...string) *exec.Cmd {
		cmd := exec.CommandContext(ctx, name, args...)
		cancel := cmd.Cancel
		cmd.Cancel = func() error {
			diagnosticEmit(map[string]any{"event": "cancel", "phase": diagnosticPhase(args), "deadline_exceeded": ctx.Err() == context.DeadlineExceeded})
			return cancel()
		}
		return cmd
	}
	dealer := NewExecutorDealer(mod, wd, budget, WithExecContext(observed))
	output := make(chan mutator.Mutator, 1)
	var wait sync.WaitGroup
	wait.Add(1)
	dealer.NewExecutor(selected, output, &wait).Start(workerpool.NewWorker(0, "diagnostic"))
	wait.Wait()
	var result mutator.Mutator
	select {
	case result = <-output:
	default:
		t.Fatal("native executor returned without a mutation result")
	}
	if len(output) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("native executor emitted extra mutation results")
	}
	copyRoot, err := wd.Get("diagnostic-0")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal("native workdir lookup failed")
	}
	restored, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(copyRoot, mod.CallingDir, "cli.go"))
	if err != nil || !bytes.Equal(restored, original) {
		t.Fatal("native mutation rollback did not restore exact source")
	}
	diagnosticEmit(map[string]any{"event": "result", "status": result.Status().String(), "rollback_exact": true, "phase_budget_ms": budget.Milliseconds(), "qualification": false})
}
